question: Which telemedicine platform served over 36 crore patients by April 2025, per the Ministry of Health?
solution:
The correct answer is __**eSanjeevani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **eSanjeevani** is the **National Telemedicine Service** of India, designed to provide online medical consultations to citizens across the **country**.
 
• By **April 2025**, the platform achieved a significant milestone by serving over **36 crore** patients, as reported by the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)**.
 
• It was conceptualized to implement **Ayushman Bharat**'s mandate of providing health and wellness services digitally, ensuring that **rural** and **remote areas** have access to quality healthcare.
 
• The platform operates through two primary modes: **eSanjeevaniAB-HWC** (provider-to-provider) and **eSanjeevaniOPD** (patient-to-doctor), facilitating a wide range of medical advice from **general medicine** to **specialized care**.
 
• This initiative has been instrumental in reducing the **out-of-pocket expenditure (OOPE)** for patients by eliminating the need for long-distance travel to reach **tertiary care hospitals**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **eSanjeevaniAB-HWC:**
 
 
• This is a **doctor-to-doctor** telemedicine system launched in **November 2019**.
 
• It connects **Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs)** at the village level with **Hubs** located at **District Hospitals** or **Medical Colleges**.
 
• This model ensures that patients at the **grassroots level** can consult with **specialists** without leaving their locality.
 
 
 
• **eSanjeevaniOPD:**
 
 
• Launched during the **COVID-19 pandemic** in **April 2020**, this variant allows **patients** to consult doctors directly from their **homes** using a **smartphone** or **laptop**.
 
• It features **video consultations**, **online prescriptions**, and **SMS notifications**, making it a highly **user-friendly** application for the general public.
 
 
 
• **Technological Backbone:**
 
 
• The platform was developed by the **Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)** in **Mohali**.
 
• It is integrated with the **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)**, allowing for the seamless creation of **Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA)** IDs and the digital storage of **health records**.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Impact:**
 
 
• States such as **Andhra Pradesh**, **Tamil Nadu**, **Karnataka**, and **Uttar Pradesh** have emerged as leaders in terms of the highest number of **teleconsultations** performed on the platform.
 
• The service supports over **20 languages**, making it accessible to a diverse population across different **geographical locations** in **India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Data and Statistics:** The platform records an average of over **4 lakh** consultations daily, showcasing its **scalability** and the growing **digital literacy** among Indian citizens.
 
• **Specializations:** Beyond general consultations, the platform offers access to **super-specialty** services in areas like **Cardiology**, **Oncology**, and **Gynaecology** through its **hub-and-spoke** architecture.
 
• **Global Recognition:** **eSanjeevani** has been recognized globally as one of the **world's largest** government-run telemedicine taxonomies, serving as a model for **digital health** interventions in developing **nations**.
 
• **Inclusion:** The service is provided **free of cost** to all citizens, fulfilling the **Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 3** of ensuring **healthy lives** and promoting **well-being** for all at all **ages**.
